Required action: Confirm executive sponsor, PFAC purpose, charter, authority, committee interfaces, agenda pipeline, current composition, participation barriers, and available measures
Evidence to review: Charter; committee map; PFAC roster; meeting records; CHNA; experience/safety/access data
Decision or output: Named sponsor; defined purpose; decision pathway; documented evidence gaps
Measure: Sponsor named; decision pathway documented; evidence gaps logged
Validation note: Unknown evidence should remain unknown until validated; do not score absence of evidence as failure

Required action: Compare current membership and participation options with priority populations and access barriers; define recruitment and mitigation actions
Evidence to review: Local population analysis; CHNA; current PFAC composition; language/disability/geography/access information
Measure: Priority populations reviewed; barriers identified; mitigation actions assigned
Validation note: Representation does not by itself establish equitable influence

Leadership objective: Put one substantive problem into the PFAC decision pathway
Required action: Select one bounded current problem; bring it to the PFAC before final decisions; document patient/family recommendations and leadership disposition
Evidence to review: Strategic priority; access/safety/experience evidence; project materials; PFAC agenda and minutes
Decision or output: One active PFAC workstream with documented recommendations and disposition
Measure: Substantive item reviewed before final decision; disposition recorded
Validation note: Start with one bounded workstream before expanding scope

Required action: Assign owners and due dates for accepted, modified, deferred, or rejected recommendations; document rationale
Evidence to review: PFAC action tracker; leadership disposition; operational plans
Measure: Owner assigned; due date assigned; action status current
Validation note: Recommendation acceptance is not required; transparent disposition and rationale are required

Required action: Define structure, process, implementation, report-back, and project-specific measures with data source and cadence
Evidence to review: Measurement plan; action tracker; governance records; project data
Measure: Measures have owner, source, cadence, and interpretation caution
Validation note: Do not attribute downstream outcomes to PFAC activity without appropriate evaluation

Required action: Review action status, evidence of implementation, unresolved barriers, project signals, and report-back completion; revise operating model as needed
Evidence to review: Action tracker; project data; PFAC feedback; leadership review
Measure: Action closure; unresolved items; report-back completion; next actions assigned
Validation note: Document what changed, what did not, why, and what will be reassessed

Required action: Report decisions and status back to patient/family partners, including deferred or rejected items and rationale
Validation note: Completion alone does not establish report-back quality; review clarity and usefulness
